datasets.name: Sentinel-2 satellite images
datasets.verbatim: cloud free (< 5% cloud) Sentinel-2 images (Level 1-C) are used, downloaded from Copernicus Open Access Hub (https:// scihub. coper nicus. eu/ dhus/#/ home, accessed on March 18, 2023).

datasets.name: ALOS PALSAR DEM
datasets.verbatim: the Advanced Land Observing Satellite-1 Phased Array type L-band Synthetic Aperture Radar Digital Elevation Model (ALOS PALSAR DEM) is used (downloaded from https:// asf. alaska. edu/, accessed on April 09, 2023).

datasets.name: Landslide inventory of Malappuram district of Kerala

methods.name: U-Net deep-learning model
methods.summary: A fully connected convolutional network (U-Net) with a down-sampling encoder and up-sampling decoder, trained on Sentinel-2 optical bands to perform pixel-based landslide detection. The model uses a slope-based Boolean elimination step to remove false positives.
methods.verbatim: Furthermore, to ensure reproducibility, a Python executable code has been developed and shared. ... The Python code used in this study is provided in the supplementary file.

code_links.name: Python code developed for this study
code_links.summary: Custom Python code developed for this study, provided as supplementary material to facilitate future research.

availability.author_statement: Data available upon request. Code shared on supplementary material.

reproducibility_assessment: Sentinel-2 and ALOS PALSAR DEM data are accessible via public portals, but the authors' landslide inventories are not referenced or linked. The custom U-Net model code is available via a persistent DOI link in the supplementary material.
